[quote=irocco;61286210][i]Following the Dharic Familys flight from Maiqahstan a few days before its annexation and integration to the Sealiphate of Irocco, they sent out scouts ahead of them to survey the underworld and above world. The purpose of these scouts was to find the Dharic opium stock and arms a new home along with the Dharic Family. They surveyed places with large criminal underbellies, neighbouring states and other foreign entities that might house them. Among the candidates and nations floated among the Dharic Family inner circle, two came to prominence. The Paramount State of Luscária and the Democratic Republic of New Westmore.

The pros and cons of each were deliberated. The Paramount State has ties with Irocco and New Westmore recently had a falling out with the Sealiphate regarding the annexation of Maiqahstan. Thus, New Westmore was selected for further investigation. It was noted by the inner circle that the Brothers 4 Life gang, fellow Shamatines, have for some time been on the backfoot in terms of Westmoran intergang conflict and may serve as a welcome home for the Maiqah peoples, and the Dharic illicit arms and opium.

It was elected among the entirety of the family that Brother Hamza would make the trek to New Westmore and serve as the opening emissary to B4L and hopefully secure a line of communication with the end goal being the trade of Opium and perhaps Dharic immigration to the B4L gang following the Maiqah Opium Cartels collapse.

Brother Hamza would be sent on a flight from Irocco to New Westmore. He would bribe airport security to allow his opium through customs. When he made landfall in New Westmore, he travelled to an estimated occupation zone of the B4L gang, and attempted to find any members that they might bring him to a higher up to begin formal negotiations that the feelers previously discussed.
[/i][/quote]
[i]Brunswick, Northern Westmore[/i]
Brother Hamza feels out of place in this new city. It is distinctly Shamatine, but yet it isn't. It is multiple leagues above a shallow representation of life in a place like Irocco, but its authenticity is diluted by the liberalism of the overarching Westmorian society, which has begun to bleed its way into the city. Or perhaps it was always there; who is to say?

He looks at a small piece of paper he was handed by the corrupt guards at the airport. It has a single name inscribed on it:

[i]Isa Abdollah Rahat.[/i]

This man must be the leader of Brothers 4 Life. But where should he begin looking? This Rahat man could be anywhere; hell, he could even be in an entirely different city and he wouldn't know until it was too late.

[b]ESPN World Cup bid[/b]

With the recent announcement by the Federation of Erene Football Association (FEFA) that the next World Cup will be held in June the following year, the Erene Sports Programming Network (ESPN) has officially lodged a application with FEFA in hopes of being granted the broadcasting rights of the World Cup in the Southern Hemisphere. Due to conflicting game times, as is common for a tournament of this magnitude, most TV channels will only broadcast select games, focusing on those that are significant to the country which the broadcaster is based in.

With ESPN, viewers in the Southern Hemisphere will be able to view any game of their choosing, including ongoing matches and replays. Other programs would include behind the scene moments, exclusive interviews with fans, players, and coaches, mini-documentaries about the journeys the national teams took to qualify for the World Cup, and talk shows featuring renowned players, pundits, and personalities.

[b]Noosa Hockey Association election[/b]

On December 26, 2027, the Noosa Hockey Association has released a poll for its supporters to vote upon the new teams name, logo, colours, and sweater design in preparations for the team joining the Major Hockey League (MHL) in the 202829 season. Currently, there is three options for fans to pick from.

[spoiler=Option 1  The Avalanches]
[b]Logo:[/b] The logo features a stylised, bold burgundy letter "A" with a mountain peak rising from its center, encircled by a blue, snow-swept avalanche-like swirl. A black hockey puck is depicted flying out of the swirl on the right side, symbolizing chaos, speed, and what the team hopes to replicate on the ice. 

[b]Colours:[/b] 	Burgundy, blue, silver, black

[b]Sweaters:[/b] https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/3/31/WCC-Uniform-COL.png
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Option 2   The Wild]
[b]Logo:[/b] It features a stylised, non-specific "wild animal" head composed of a Minnesota forest landscape at dusk. It uses negative space to form a silhouette containing a red sky, evergreen trees, and a river. The overall shape is a snarling, ambiguous creature often interpreted as a bear, cat, or wolf. Its features are formed by nature: the ear is a crescent moon, the eye is a star, and the mouth is a river.

[b]Colours:[/b] Forest green, iron range red, harvest gold, Noosa wheat

[b]Sweaters:[/b] https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/2/2f/WCC-Uniform-MIN.png/330px-WCC-Uniform-MIN.png
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Option 3  The Golden Knights]
[b]Logo:[/b] The primary logo is a steel gray and gold [i]barbute[/i]-style helmet (resembling 15th-century armor) centered on a black shield. It signifies strength and the "warrior class," featuring a 3D effect where the helmet appears to break the shield's top boundary. 

[b]Colours:[/b] Steel grey, gold, red, black

[b]Sweaters:[/b] https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/7/7f/WCP-Uniform-VGK.png
[/spoiler]
